```cpp
#include <type_traits>

namespace otio {

struct Rational {
    int64_t num;
    int64_t den;

    constexpr Rational(int64_t n = 0, int64_t d = 1) noexcept : num(n), den(d) { normalize(); }

    constexpr void normalize() noexcept {
        if (den < 0) { num = -num; den = -den; }
        int64_t g = std::gcd(num, den);
        if (g != 0) { num /= g; den /= g; }
    }

    constexpr double to_double() const noexcept { return static_cast<double>(num) / den; }

    constexpr Rational operator+(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den + o.num * den, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator-(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den - o.num * den, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator*(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.num, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator/(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den, den * o.num);
    }
    constexpr bool operator<(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num * o.den < o.num * den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator<=(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num * o.den <= o.num * den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator==(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num == o.num && den == o.den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator!=(const Rational& o) const noexcept { return !(*this == o); }
};

struct TimeRange {
    Rational start;
    Rational duration;

    constexpr TimeRange() noexcept = default;
    constexpr TimeRange(Rational s, Rational d) noexcept : start(s), duration(d) {}

    constexpr Rational end() const noexcept { return start + duration; }
    constexpr bool contains(Rational t) const noexcept { return start <= t && t < end(); }
    constexpr bool intersects(const TimeRange& o) const noexcept {
        return start < o.end() && o.start < end();
    }
    constexpr TimeRange intersection(const TimeRange& o) const noexcept {
        Rational s = std::max(start, o.start);
        Rational e = std::min(end(), o.end());
        return (s < e) ? TimeRange(s, e - s) : TimeRange(Rational(0), Rational(0));
    }
};

struct Clip {
    TimeRange source_range;
    TimeRange target_range;
    int track_index;
    void* tensor_data;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> tensor_shape;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> tensor_strides;
};

class AlignedMemoryPool {
    static constexpr size_t ALIGNMENT = 64;
    std::vector<std::byte> buffer_;
    size_t offset_ = 0;
    std::vector<size_t> checkpoints_;

public:
    explicit AlignedMemoryPool(size_t capacity_bytes) {
        buffer_.resize(capacity_bytes + ALIGNMENT - 1);
        offset_ = (reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(buffer_.data()) + ALIGNMENT - 1) & ~(ALIGNMENT - 1);
        offset_ -= reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(buffer_.data());
    }

    void* allocate(size_t bytes) noexcept {
        size_t aligned_bytes = (bytes + ALIGNMENT - 1) & ~(ALIGNMENT - 1);
        if (offset_ + aligned_bytes > buffer_.size()) return nullptr;
        void* ptr = buffer_.data() + offset_;
        offset_ += aligned_bytes;
        return ptr;
    }

    void checkpoint() noexcept { checkpoints_.push_back(offset_); }
    void rollback() noexcept {
        if (!checkpoints_.empty()) {
            offset_ = checkpoints_.back();
            checkpoints_.pop_back();
        }
    }
    void reset() noexcept { offset_ = 0; checkpoints_.clear(); }
    size_t used() const noexcept { return offset_; }
    size_t capacity() const noexcept { return buffer_.size(); }
};

class TensorView {
    void* data_;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> shape_;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> strides_;

public:
    TensorView() noexcept : data_(nullptr), shape_{0,0,0}, strides_{0,0,0} {}
    TensorView(void* data, std::array<int64_t,3> shape, std::array<int64_t,3> strides) noexcept
        : data_(data), shape_(shape), strides_(strides) {}

    void* data() const noexcept { return data_; }
    const std::array<int64_t,3>& shape() const noexcept { return shape_; }
    const std::array<int64_t,3>& strides() const noexcept { return strides_; }

    TensorView permute(std::array<int,3> axes) const noexcept {
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_shape, new_strides;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            new_shape[i] = shape_[axes[i]];
            new_strides[i] = strides_[axes[i]];
        }
        return TensorView(data_, new_shape, new_strides);
    }

    TensorView slice(int dim, int64_t start, int64_t end) const noexcept {
        assert(dim >= 0 && dim < 3);
        assert(start >= 0 && end <= shape_[dim]);
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_shape = shape_;
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_strides = strides_;
        new_shape[dim] = end - start;
        char* base = static_cast<char*>(data_) + start * strides_[dim];
        return TensorView(base, new_shape, new_strides);
    }
};

class TrackGapResolver {
    AlignedMemoryPool& pool_;
    std::vector<Clip> clips_;
    std::vector<TimeRange> gaps_;

public:
    explicit TrackGapResolver(AlignedMemoryPool& pool) noexcept : pool_(pool) {}

    void add_clip(const Clip& clip) { clips_.push_back(clip); }

    void resolve_gaps(Rational track_start, Rational track_end, Rational frame_rate) noexcept {
        if (clips_.empty()) {
            gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(track_start, track_end - track_start));
            return;
        }

        std::sort(clips_.begin(), clips_.end(),
            [](const Clip& a, const Clip& b) { return a.target_range.start < b.target_range.start; });

        Rational current = track_start;
        for (const auto& clip : clips_) {
            if (current < clip.target_range.start) {
                gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(current, clip.target_range.start - current));
            }
            current = std::max(current, clip.target_range.end());
        }
        if (current < track_end) {
            gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(current, track_end - current));
        }
    }

    const std::vector<TimeRange>& gaps() const noexcept { return gaps_; }
    const std::vector<Clip>& clips() const noexcept { return clips_; }

    void clear() noexcept { clips_.clear(); gaps_.clear(); }
};

class TimeRangeResampler {
    AlignedMemoryPool& pool_;
    Rational frame_rate_;

public:
    TimeRangeResampler(AlignedMemoryPool& pool, Rational frame_rate) noexcept
        : pool_(pool), frame_rate_(frame_rate) {}

    TensorView resample(const TensorView& src, const TimeRange& src_range,
                        const TimeRange& dst_range, int channel_dim = 0) noexcept {
        int64_t src_frames = static_cast<int64_t>((src_range.duration * frame_rate_).to_double() + 0.5);
        int64_t dst_frames = static_cast<int64_t>((dst_range.duration * frame_rate_).to_double() + 0.5);

        if (src_frames <= 0 || dst_frames <= 0) return TensorView();

        std::array<int64_t,3> src_shape = src.shape();
        std::array<int64_t,3> dst_shape = src_shape;
        dst_shape[channel_dim] = dst_frames;

        size_t elem_size = 4;
        size_t dst_bytes = dst_shape[0] * dst_shape[1] * dst_shape[2] * elem_size;
        void* dst_data = pool_.allocate(dst_bytes);
        if (!dst_data) return TensorView();

        std::array<int64_t,3> dst_strides = {
            dst_shape[1] * dst_shape[2] * elem_size,
            dst_shape[2] * elem_size,
            elem_size
        };

        const float* src_ptr = static_cast<const float*>(src.data());
        float* dst_ptr = static_cast<float*>(dst_data);

        double ratio = static_cast<double>(src_frames) / dst_frames;

        for (int64_t c = 0; c < dst_shape[0]; ++c) {
            for (int64_t h = 0; h < dst_shape[1]; ++h) {
                for (int64_t w = 0; w < dst_shape[2]; ++w) {
                    double src_idx = (c * ratio);
                    int64_t src_c = static_cast<int64_t>(src_idx);
                    double frac = src_idx - src_c;
                    src_c = std::min(src_c, src_shape[channel_dim] - 1);

                    size_t src_offset = 0;
                    if (channel_dim == 0) src_offset = src_c * src.strides()[0] + h * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                    else if (channel_dim == 1) src_offset = h * src.strides()[0] + src_c * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                    else src_offset = h * src.strides()[0] + w * src.strides()[1] + src_c * src.strides()[2];

                    float val = src_ptr[src_offset / elem_size];
                    if (frac > 0 && src_c + 1 < src_shape[channel_dim]) {
                        size_t src_offset2 = 0;
                        if (channel_dim == 0) src_offset2 = (src_c+1) * src.strides()[0] + h * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                        else if (channel_dim == 1) src_offset2 = h * src.strides()[0] + (src_c+1) * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                        else src_offset2 = h * src.strides()[0] + w * src.strides()[1] + (src_c+1) * src.strides()[2];
                        val = val * (1.0 - frac) + src_ptr[src_offset2 / elem_size] * frac;
                    }

                    size_t dst_offset = c * dst_strides[0] + h * dst_strides[1] + w * dst_strides[2];
                    dst_ptr[dst_offset / elem_size] = val;
                }
            }
        }

        return TensorView(dst_data, dst_shape, dst_strides);
    }
};

} // namespace otio

int main() {
    using namespace otio;
    using namespace std::chrono;

    constexpr size_t POOL_SIZE = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
    AlignedMemoryPool pool(POOL_SIZE);

    Rational frame_rate(30000, 1001);
    TimeRangeResampler resampler(pool, frame_rate);
    TrackGapResolver resolver(pool);

    std::array<int64_t,3> shape = {3, 1080, 1920};
    std::array<int64_t,3> strides = {1080*1920*4, 1920*4, 4};
    void* tensor_data = pool.allocate(shape[0] * shape[1] * shape[2] * 4);
    assert(tensor_data && reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(tensor_data) % 64 == 0);

    float* fdata = static_cast<float*>(tensor_data);

    TensorView src_tensor(tensor_data, shape, strides);

    Clip clip1{TimeRange(Rational(0), Rational(100,1)), TimeRange(Rational(0), Rational(100,1)), 0, tensor_data, shape, strides};
    Clip clip2{TimeRange(Rational(100,1), Rational(50,1)), TimeRange(Rational(150,1), Rational(50,1)), 0, tensor_data, shape, strides};
    resolver.add_clip(clip1);
    resolver.add_clip(clip2);

    resolver.resolve_gaps(Rational(0), Rational(300,1), frame_rate);

    assert(resolver.gaps().size() == 2);
    assert(resolver.gaps()[0].start == Rational(100,1) && resolver.gaps()[0].duration == Rational(50,1));
    assert(resolver.gaps()[1].start == Rational(200,1) && resolver.gaps()[1].duration == Rational(100,1));

    TimeRange src_range(Rational(0), Rational(100,1));
    TimeRange dst_range(Rational(0), Rational(50,1));

    pool.checkpoint();
    auto start = high_resolution_clock::now();

    constexpr int ITERATIONS = 1000;
    TensorView result;
    for (int i = 0; i < ITERATIONS; ++i) {
        result = resampler.resample(src_tensor, src_range, dst_range, 0);
        assert(result.data() && reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(result.data()) % 64 == 0);
        pool.rollback();
    }

    auto end = high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = duration_cast<microseconds>(end - start).count();

    std::cout << "Iterations: " << ITERATIONS << "\n";
    std::cout << "Total time: " << duration << " us\n";
    std::cout << "Per iteration: " << (duration / static_cast<double>(ITERATIONS)) << " us\n";
    std::cout << "Pool used: " << pool.used() << " bytes\n";
    std::cout << "Result shape: " << result.shape()[0] << "x" << result.shape()[1] << "x" << result.shape()[2] << "\n";
    std::cout << "Result strides: " << result.strides()[0] << ", " << result.strides()[1] << ", " << result.strides()[2] << "\n";

    TensorView permuted = result.permute({1, 2, 0});
    std::cout << "Permuted shape: " << permuted.shape()[0] << "x" << permuted.shape()[1] << "x" << permuted.shape()[2] << "\n";
    std::cout << "Permuted strides: " << permuted.strides()[0] << ", " << permuted.strides()[1] << ", " << permuted.strides()[2] << "\n";
    assert(permuted.data() == result.data());

    TensorView sliced = result.slice(1, 100, 200);
    std::cout << "Sliced shape: " << sliced.shape()[0] << "x" << sliced.shape()[1] << "x" << sliced.shape()[2] << "\n";
    assert(sliced.shape()[1] == 100);

    std::cout << "All invariants verified. Alignment: 64-byte OK.\n";
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// WGS84 Ellipsoid Constants
constexpr double a = 6378137.0;           // Semi-major axis (meters)
constexpr double f = 1.0 / 298.257223563; // Flattening
constexpr double e2 = 2 * f - f * f;      // Eccentricity squared

// Authalic Sphere Radius (Equal-Area Sphere)
// R_A = a * sqrt(1 - e^2/2 - ... ) -> Closed form via integral of Gaussian curvature
// R_A^2 = (a^2/2) * (1 + (1-e^2)/e * atanh(e))
constexpr double e = std::sqrt(e2);
constexpr double R_authalic = a * std::sqrt(0.5 * (1.0 + (1.0 - e2) / e * std::atanh(e)));

// Convert Geodetic Latitude (radians) to Authalic Latitude (radians)
// beta = asin( q / q_p )
// q = (1-e^2) * ( sin(phi)/(1-e^2 sin^2 phi) - 1/(2e) ln((1-e sin phi)/(1+e sin phi)) )
// q_p = q(pi/2)
inline double geodetic_to_authalic_lat(double phi) noexcept {
    const double sin_phi = std::sin(phi);
    const double e_sin = e * sin_phi;
    const double denom = 1.0 - e2 * sin_phi * sin_phi;

    // q(phi)
    double q = (1.0 - e2) * (sin_phi / denom);
    if (std::abs(e) > std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon()) {
        q -= (1.0 - e2) / (2.0 * e) * std::log((1.0 - e_sin) / (1.0 + e_sin));
    }

    // q_p (pole)
    static const double q_p = []() {
        double qp = (1.0 - e2) * (1.0 / (1.0 - e2));
        qp -= (1.0 - e2) / (2.0 * e) * std::log((1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e));
        return qp;
    }();

    const double ratio = q / q_p;
    // Clamp for numerical safety at poles
    return std::asin(std::clamp(ratio, -1.0, 1.0));
}

// Spherical Polygon Area via Girard's Theorem (Vector Form)

// Simplified robust implementation: Sum of atan2( |cross|, dot ) for edges, corrected for winding.
// Standard formula: Area = R^2 * [ Sum( atan2( |v_i x v_{i+1}|, v_i . v_{i+1} ) ) - (N-2)*pi ]
// This gives positive area for CCW (vertices ordered counter-clockwise looking from outside).
// For geographic polygons (CCW = interior on left), this matches standard convention.
double spherical_polygon_area(const std::vector<Vec3>& verts) noexcept {
    const size_t n = verts.size();
    if (n < 3) return 0.0;

    double sum_angles = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const Vec3& v1 = verts[i];
        const Vec3& v2 = verts[(i + 1) % n];
        Vec3 cr = cross(v1, v2);
        double cr_norm = norm(cr);
        double dt = dot(v1, v2);
        // atan2(y, x) handles quadrant correctly. Angle is positive.
        sum_angles += std::atan2(cr_norm, dt);
    }

    // Spherical Excess E = Sum(angles) - (N-2)*pi
    double excess = sum_angles - (static_cast<double>(n) - 2.0) * M_PI;
    return excess * R_authalic * R_authalic;
}

    return std::abs(sum) * 0.5; // Returns deg^2

// Planar Shoelace in Local ENU (East-North-Up) Projection centered at centroid
// This is the standard "Planar Approximation" used in GIS for small areas.
double planar_shoelace_enu(const std::vector<std::pair<double, double>>& coords_deg) noexcept {
    size_t n = coords_deg.size();
    if (n < 3) return 0.0;

    // 1. Compute Centroid (spherical avg approx)
    double sum_lat = 0, sum_lon = 0;
    for (auto& p : coords_deg) {
        sum_lat += p.second;
        sum_lon += p.first;
    }
    double lat0 = sum_lat / n * M_PI / 180.0;
    double lon0 = sum_lon / n * M_PI / 180.0;

    // 2. Project to Local ENU (meters)
    // Radius of curvature in Prime Vertical (N) and Meridian (M)
    double sin_lat = std::sin(lat0);
    double N = a / std::sqrt(1.0 - e2 * sin_lat * sin_lat);
    double M = N * (1.0 - e2) / (1.0 - e2 * sin_lat * sin_lat);

    std::vector<std::pair<double, double>> enu;
    enu.reserve(n);
    for (auto& p : coords_deg) {
        double dLon = (p.first * M_PI / 180.0) - lon0;
        double dLat = (p.second * M_PI / 180.0) - lat0;
        double E = dLon * N * std::cos(lat0);
        double N_ = dLat * M;
        enu.emplace_back(E, N_);
    }

    // 3. Shoelace on ENU (meters)
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        size_t j = (i + 1) % n;
        sum += enu[i].first * enu[j].second - enu[j].first * enu[i].second;
    }
    return std::abs(sum) * 0.5;
}
```

struct half {

    half() = default;
    half(uint16_t v) : x(v) {}

        int32_t  exp  = (u >> 23) & 0xFF;

            // Normalize subnormal

            exp++;
            mant &= ~0x800000;
        }
        // Adjust exponent bias (127 -> 15)
        exp = exp - 127 + 15;

        if (exp <= 0) { // Underflow to subnormal/zero
            int shift = 1 - exp;
            if (shift >= 24) return half(sign);
            mant = (mant | 0x800000) >> shift;
            exp = 0;
        }
        return half(sign | (exp << 10) | ((mant + 0x1000) >> 13)); // Round to nearest even
    }
    float to_float() const {
        uint16_t h = x;
        uint32_t sign = (h >> 15) & 1;
        uint32_t exp  = (h >> 10) & 0x1F;
        uint32_t mant = h & 0x3FF;

        if (exp == 0x1F) { // Inf/NaN
            uint32_t u = (sign << 31) | 0x7F800000 | (mant << 13);
            return *reinterpret_cast<float*>(&u);
        }
        if (exp == 0) { // Zero or subnormal
            if (mant == 0) {
                uint32_t u = sign << 31;
                return *reinterpret_cast<float*>(&u);
            }
            // Normalize subnormal
            while ((mant & 0x400) == 0) { mant <<= 1; exp--; }
            exp++;
            mant &= ~0x400;
        }
        uint32_t u = (sign << 31) | ((exp + 127 - 15) << 23) | (mant << 13);
        return *reinterpret_cast<float*>(&u);
    }
};

// ================================================================
// Warp shuffle emulation (32 lanes)
// ================================================================
constexpr int WARP_SIZE = 32;
constexpr uint32_t FULL_MASK = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

struct Warp {
    float regs[WARP_SIZE];
    float shfl_xor_sync(uint32_t mask, float val, int lane_mask, int width = WARP_SIZE) {
        int src_lane = (lane_id() ^ lane_mask) & (width - 1);
        return regs[src_lane];
    }
    int lane_id() const { return 0; } // Overridden in kernel context
};

// ================================================================
// Block/Grid simulation
// ================================================================
constexpr int BLOCK_DIM_X = 128; // 4 warps
constexpr int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_DIM_X / WARP_SIZE;
constexpr int SHARED_MEM_BYTES = 48 * 1024;

struct ThreadContext {
    int threadIdx_x;
    int blockIdx_x;
    int warp_id() const { return threadIdx_x / WARP_SIZE; }
    int lane_id() const { return threadIdx_x % WARP_SIZE; }
};

struct BlockContext {
    ThreadContext threads[BLOCK_DIM_X];
    float shared_mem[SHARED_MEM_BYTES / sizeof(float)];
    Warp warps[WARPS_PER_BLOCK];
};

// ================================================================
// Online Softmax with Warp-Level Reduction (FP32 accumulation)
// ================================================================
__device__ inline float warp_reduce_max(float val, Warp& warp, int lane) {
    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        float tmp = warp.shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, val, offset);
        val = fmaxf(val, tmp);
    }
    return warp.shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, val, 0); // Broadcast to all lanes
}

__device__ inline float warp_reduce_sum(float val, Warp& warp, int lane) {
    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        float tmp = warp.shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, val, offset);
        val += tmp;
    }
    return warp.shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, val, 0);
}

// Kernel: Each warp computes softmax over a row of length N (4096)
// Grid: (M / WARPS_PER_BLOCK) blocks, each block has 4 warps -> 4 rows per block
void online_softmax_kernel(const half* __restrict__ input,
                           half* __restrict__ output,
                           int M, int N,
                           BlockContext& block) {
    const int row = block.blockIdx_x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + block.threads[0].warp_id();
    if (row >= M) return;

    Warp& warp = block.warps[block.threads[0].warp_id()];
    const int lane = block.threads[0].lane_id();

    // Online softmax state (FP32 for stability)
    float max_val = -INFINITY;
    float sum_exp = 0.0f;

    // Each thread processes N/WARP_SIZE elements (strided)
    for (int col = lane; col < N; col += WARP_SIZE) {
        float x = input[row * N + col].to_float();

        // Update max (online)
        float old_max = max_val;
        max_val = fmaxf(max_val, x);

        // Rescale sum_exp and add new term
        sum_exp = sum_exp * expf(old_max - max_val) + expf(x - max_val);
    }

    // Warp-level reduction for max and sum_exp
    float warp_max = warp_reduce_max(max_val, warp, lane);
    float warp_sum = warp_reduce_sum(sum_exp * expf(max_val - warp_max), warp, lane);

    // Final normalization factor
    float inv_sum = 1.0f / warp_sum;

    // Write back normalized values
    for (int col = lane; col < N; col += WARP_SIZE) {
        float x = input[row * N + col].to_float();
        float y = expf(x - warp_max) * inv_sum;
        output[row * N + col] = half::from_float(y);
    }
}

// ================================================================
// Host launcher & verification
// ================================================================
int main() {
    constexpr int M = 4096, N = 4096;
    std::vector<half> h_input(M * N), h_output(M * N), h_ref(M * N);

    // Initialize input with random values in [-10, 10] to test stability
    for (int i = 0; i < M * N; ++i) {
        float v = (static_cast<float>(rand()) / RAND_MAX) * 20.0f - 10.0f;
        h_input[i] = half::from_float(v);
    }

    // Reference CPU softmax (FP32)
    for (int row = 0; row < M; ++row) {
        float max_val = -INFINITY;
        for (int col = 0; col < N; ++col) {
            max_val = fmaxf(max_val, h_input[row * N + col].to_float());
        }
        float sum = 0.0f;
        for (int col = 0; col < N; ++col) {
            sum += expf(h_input[row * N + col].to_float() - max_val);
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < N; ++col) {
            float y = expf(h_input[row * N + col].to_float() - max_val) / sum;
            h_ref[row * N + col] = half::from_float(y);
        }
    }

    // Simulate kernel launch
    const int grid_size = (M + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK;
    for (int block_idx = 0; block_idx < grid_size; ++block_idx) {
        BlockContext block;
        block.blockIdx_x = block_idx;
        for (int t = 0; t < BLOCK_DIM_X; ++t) {
            block.threads[t].threadIdx_x = t;
            block.threads[t].blockIdx_x = block_idx;
        }
        // Initialize warp lane_id for shuffle emulation
        for (int w = 0; w < WARPS_PER_BLOCK; ++w) {
            for (int l = 0; l < WARP_SIZE; ++l) {
                block.warps[w].regs[l] = 0.0f;
            }
        }
        online_softmax_kernel(h_input.data(), h_output.data(), M, N, block);
    }

    // Verify numerical accuracy (max absolute error < 1e-3)
    float max_err = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < M * N; ++i) {
        float err = fabsf(h_output[i].to_float() - h_ref[i].to_float());
        if (err > max_err) max_err = err;
    }
    printf("Max absolute error: %e\n", max_err);
    if (max_err > 1e-3f) {
        printf("FAIL: Error tolerance exceeded\n");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("PASS: Numerical stability verified\n");
    return 0;
}

Complexity Analysis:
- Time: O(M*N) total work, O(N/32) steps per warp with O(log 32) reduction depth.
- Space: O(1) registers per thread, 48KB shared memory (unused in this kernel).
- Numerical: FP32 accumulation avoids FP16 overflow/underflow; online max update ensures stability.

```cpp
// Rational time representation
struct RationalTime {
    int64_t numerator;
    int64_t denominator;
    
    // Normalize rational (keep denominator positive)
    void normalize() {
        if (denominator < 0) {
            numerator = -numerator;
            denominator = -denominator;
        }
        int64_t g = std::gcd(std::abs(numerator), denominator);
        numerator /= g;
        denominator /= g;
    }
    
    // Comparison operators
    bool operator==(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return numerator * other.denominator == other.numerator * denominator;
    }
    bool operator<(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return numerator * other.denominator < other.numerator * denominator;
    }
    bool operator<=(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return *this < other || *this == other;
    }
    
    // Arithmetic
    RationalTime operator+(const RationalTime& other) const {
        RationalTime result{
            numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator
        };
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    RationalTime operator-(const RationalTime& other) const {
        RationalTime result{
            numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator
        };
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    RationalTime operator*(int64_t scalar) const {
        RationalTime result{numerator * scalar, denominator};
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    double to_double() const {
        return static_cast<double>(numerator) / static_cast<double>(denominator);
    }
};

// Zero-copy 3D tensor view with stride permutation
template<typename T>
class Tensor3DView {
public:
    using value_type = T;
    using pointer = T*;
    using const_pointer = const T*;
    using size_type = size_t;
    
    // Stride order: [dim0_stride, dim1_stride, dim2_stride]
    // Default: row-major (C-contiguous): [dim1*dim2, dim2, 1]
    
    Tensor3DView() = default;
    
    Tensor3DView(pointer data, 
                 size_type dim0, size_type dim1, size_type dim2,
                 std::array<size_type, 3> strides = {})
        : data_(data), dims_{dim0, dim1, dim2} {
        if (strides.empty()) {
            // Default row-major strides
            strides_[0] = dim1 * dim2;
            strides_[1] = dim2;
            strides_[2] = 1;
        } else {
            strides_ = strides;
        }
    }
    
    // Permute dimensions (zero-copy, just changes stride/view)
    Tensor3DView permute(std::array<int, 3> new_order) const {
        assert(new_order[0] >= 0 && new_order[0] < 3);
        assert(new_order[1] >= 0 && new_order[1] < 3);
        assert(new_order[2] >= 0 && new_order[2] < 3);
        assert(new_order[0] != new_order[1] && new_order[0] != new_order[2] && new_order[1] != new_order[2]);
        
        std::array<size_type, 3> new_dims;
        std::array<size_type, 3> new_strides;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            new_dims[i] = dims_[new_order[i]];
            new_strides[i] = strides_[new_order[i]];
        }
        
        return Tensor3DView(data_, new_dims[0], new_dims[1], new_dims[2], new_strides);
    }
    
    // Transpose (swap two dimensions)
    Tensor3DView transpose(int dim0, int dim1) const {
        std::array<int, 3> order = {0, 1, 2};
        std::swap(order[dim0], order[dim1]);
        return permute(order);
    }
    
    // Access element (with bounds checking in debug)
    T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) {
        assert(i < dims_[0] && j < dims_[1] && k < dims_[2]);
        return data_[i * strides_[0] + j * strides_[1] + k * strides_[2]];
    }
    
    const T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) const {
        assert(i < dims_[0] && j < dims_[1] && k < dims_[2]);
        return data_[i * strides_[0] + j * strides_[1] + k * strides_[2]];
    }
    
    // Raw pointer access for NumPy/Pybind11 interop
    pointer data() { return data_; }
    const_pointer data() const { return data_; }
    
    // Shape and strides for NumPy array creation
    std::array<size_type, 3> shape() const { return dims_; }
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides() const { return strides_; }
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides_bytes() const { 
        return {strides_[0] * sizeof(T), strides_[1] * sizeof(T), strides_[2] * sizeof(T)}; 
    }
    
    size_type size() const { return dims_[0] * dims_[1] * dims_[2]; }
    size_type ndim() const { return 3; }
    
    // Check if contiguous
    bool is_contiguous() const {
        return strides_[0] == dims_[1] * dims_[2] && 
               strides_[1] == dims_[2] && 
               strides_[2] == 1;
    }
    
private:
    pointer data_ = nullptr;
    std::array<size_type, 3> dims_ = {0, 0, 0};
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides_ = {0, 0, 0};
};

// Resampler for rational time ranges
class RationalTimeResampler {
public:
    // Resample clips from source rate to target rate
    static void resample_track(Track& track, 
                               const RationalTime& source_rate,
                               const RationalTime& target_rate) {
        if (source_rate == target_rate) return;
        
        // Conversion factor: target_rate / source_rate
        RationalTime factor{
            target_rate.numerator * source_rate.denominator,
            target_rate.denominator * source_rate.numerator
        };
        factor.normalize();
        
        for (auto& clip : track.clips) {
            // Resample source range
            clip.source_range.start_time = multiply_rational(clip.source_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.source_range.duration = multiply_rational(clip.source_range.duration, factor);
            
            // Resample target range
            clip.target_range.start_time = multiply_rational(clip.target_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.target_range.duration = multiply_rational(clip.target_range.duration, factor);
        }
        
        // Resample track duration
        track.duration = multiply_rational(track.duration, factor);
    }
    
    // Resample a time range
    static TimeRange resample_range(const TimeRange& range,
                                    const RationalTime& source_rate,
                                    const RationalTime& target_rate) {
        RationalTime factor{
            target_rate.numerator * source_rate.denominator,
            target_rate.denominator * source_rate.numerator
        };
        factor.normalize();
        
        return TimeRange{
            multiply_rational(range.start_time, factor),
            multiply_rational(range.duration, factor)
        };
    }
    
private:
    static RationalTime multiply_rational(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) {
        RationalTime result{a.numerator * b.numerator, a.denominator * b.denominator};
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
};

// Media timeline composer (OpenTimelineIO style)
class TimelineComposer {
public:
    struct CompositionResult {
        std::vector<Clip> composed_clips;
        std::vector<TimeRange> unresolved_gaps;
        bool success = true;
    };
    
    // Compose multiple tracks into single timeline
    static CompositionResult compose_tracks(const std::vector<Track*>& tracks,
                                            const RationalTime& timeline_duration) {
        CompositionResult result;
        
        // Collect all clips from all tracks
        std::vector<Clip> all_clips;
        size_t total_clips = 0;
        for (const auto* track : tracks) {
            total_clips += track->clips.size();
        }
        all_clips.reserve(total_clips);
        
        for (const auto* track : tracks) {
            for (const auto& clip : track->clips) {
                all_clips.push_back(clip);
            }
        }
        
        // Sort by target start time
        std::sort(all_clips.begin(), all_clips.end(),
                  [](const Clip& a, const Clip& b) {
                      return a.target_range.start_time < b.target_range.start_time;
                  });
        
        // Merge overlapping clips (higher track index wins - last in vector)
        std::vector<Clip> merged;
        merged.reserve(all_clips.size());
        
        for (const auto& clip : all_clips) {
            if (merged.empty() || !merged.back().target_range.overlaps(clip.target_range)) {
                merged.push_back(clip);
            } else {
                // Overlap - clip wins (replace overlapping portion)
                auto& last = merged.back();
                auto intersection = last.target_range.intersection(clip.target_range);
                if (intersection) {
                    // Split last clip if needed
                    if (last.target_range.start_time < intersection->start_time) {
                        // Keep prefix of last clip
                        Clip prefix = last;
                        prefix.target_range.duration = intersection->start_time - last.target_range.start_time;
                        prefix.source_range.duration = intersection->start_time - last.source_range.start_time;
                        merged.back() = prefix;
                        
                        // Add the new clip
                        merged.push_back(clip);
                        
                        // Add suffix of last clip if it extends beyond
                        if (last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() > intersection->end_time_exclusive()) {
                            Clip suffix = last;
                            suffix.target_range.start_time = intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.target_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.source_range.start_time = intersection->end_time_exclusive() - last.target_range.start_time + last.source_range.start_time;
                            suffix.source_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            merged.push_back(suffix);
                        }
                    } else {
                        // New clip completely covers or starts at same time
                        merged.back() = clip;
                    }
                } else {
                    merged.push_back(clip);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Find gaps in composed timeline
        RationalTime current_time{0, 1};
        for (const auto& clip : merged) {
            if (clip.target_range.start_time > current_time) {
                result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(
                    TimeRange{current_time, clip.target_range.start_time - current_time}
                );
            }
            current_time = clip.target_range.end_time_exclusive();
        }
        
        if (current_time < timeline_duration) {
            result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(
                TimeRange{current_time, timeline_duration - current_time}
            );
        }
        
        result.composed_clips = std::move(merged);
        return result;
    }
};

void test_rational_time() {
    RationalTime a{1, 24};    // 1/24 sec (1 frame at 24fps)
    RationalTime b{1, 30};    // 1/30 sec (1 frame at 30fps)
    
    assert(a < RationalTime{1, 12});
    assert(RationalTime{2, 24} == RationalTime{1, 12});
    assert((a + b).numerator == 54 && (a + b).denominator == 720); // 1/24 + 1/30 = 9/120 = 3/40
    assert((a - RationalTime{1, 48}).numerator == 1 && (a - RationalTime{1, 48}).denominator == 48);
    
    // Test normalization with negative
    RationalTime neg{-1, 24};
    neg.normalize();
    assert(neg.numerator == -1 && neg.denominator == 24);
    
    RationalTime neg_denom{1, -24};
    neg_denom.normalize();
    assert(neg_denom.numerator == -1 && neg_denom.denominator == 24);
}

void test_time_range() {
    TimeRange r1{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}};  // [0, 10)
    TimeRange r2{RationalTime{5, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}};   // [5, 15)
    TimeRange r3{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{5, 1}};   // [10, 15)
    TimeRange r4{RationalTime{15, 1}, RationalTime{5, 1}};   // [15, 20)
    
    assert(r1.overlaps(r2));
    assert(!r1.overlaps(r3));  // Exact boundary - no overlap
    assert(!r1.overlaps(r4));
    
    auto inter = r1.intersection(r2);
    assert(inter.has_value());
    assert(inter->start_time == RationalTime{5, 1});
    assert(inter->duration == RationalTime{5, 1});
    
    auto inter2 = r1.intersection(r3);
    assert(!inter2.has_value());  // Exact boundary
    
    assert(r1.contains(RationalTime{0, 1}));
    assert(r1.contains(RationalTime{9, 1}));
    assert(!r1.contains(RationalTime{10, 1}));  // Exclusive end
    assert(!r1.contains(RationalTime{-1, 1}));
}

void test_track_gaps() {
    Track track;
    track.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track.reserve_gaps(10);
    
    // Empty track - entire duration is gap
    auto gaps = track.find_gaps();
    assert(gaps.size() == 1);
    assert(gaps[0].start_time == RationalTime{0, 1});
    assert(gaps[0].duration == RationalTime{100, 1});
    
    // Add clips
    track.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{20, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 2},  // Gap [10, 20)
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{20, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{30, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 3},
    };
    
    gaps = track.find_gaps();
    assert(gaps.size() == 2);
    assert(gaps[0].start_time == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(gaps[0].duration == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(gaps[1].start_time == RationalTime{40, 1});
    assert(gaps[1].duration == RationalTime{60, 1});
    
    // Test gap resolution by extending
    track.resolve_gaps(true);
    assert(track.clips.size() == 3);
    // First clip extended to cover [0, 20)
    assert(track.clips[0].target_range.duration == RationalTime{20, 1});
    // Second clip now starts at 20
    assert(track.clips[1].target_range.start_time == RationalTime{20, 1});
    
    // Test gap resolution with filler
    Track track2;
    track2.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track2.reserve_gaps(10);
    track2.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{30, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 2},
    };
    track2.resolve_gaps(false);
    assert(track2.clips.size() == 3);
    assert(track2.clips[1].is_gap());
    assert(track2.clips[1].target_range.start_time == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(track2.clips[1].target_range.duration == RationalTime{20, 1});
}

void test_resampler() {
    Track track;
    track.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{24, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{24, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 2},
    };
    
    // Resample from 24fps to 30fps
    RationalTime source_rate{1, 24};
    RationalTime target_rate{1, 30};
    
    RationalTimeResampler::resample_track(track, source_rate, target_rate);
    
    // 24 frames at 24fps = 1 second = 30 frames at 30fps
    assert(track.clips[0].target_range.duration == RationalTime{30, 30});  // 1 second
    assert(track.clips[1].target_range.duration == RationalTime{30, 30});  // 1 second
    assert(track.duration == RationalTime{60, 30});  // 2 seconds
}

void test_tensor3d_permute() {
    // Create 3D data: 2x3x4 = 24 elements
    std::vector<float> data(24);
    std::iota(data.begin(), data.end(), 0.0f);
    
    // Row-major view: [2, 3, 4] with strides [12, 4, 1]
    Tensor3DView<float> view(data.data(), 2, 3, 4);
    assert(view.is_contiguous());
    
    // Test access
    assert(view(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);
    assert(view(0, 0, 3) == 3.0f);
    assert(view(0, 1, 0) == 4.0f);
    assert(view(1, 0, 0) == 12.0f);
    assert(view(1, 2, 3) == 23.0f);
    
    // Permute to [4, 2, 3] (swap dim0 and dim2)
    auto permuted = view.permute({2, 0, 1});
    assert(permuted.shape() == std::array<size_t, 3>{4, 2, 3});
    assert(permuted.strides() == std::array<size_t, 3>{1, 12, 4});
    
    // Verify data access through permuted view
    assert(permuted(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);   // Original (0,0,0)
    assert(permuted(3, 0, 0) == 3.0f);   // Original (0,0,3)
    assert(permuted(0, 0, 1) == 4.0f);   // Original (0,1,0)
    assert(permuted(0, 1, 0) == 12.0f);  // Original (1,0,0)
    assert(permuted(3, 1, 2) == 23.0f);  // Original (1,2,3)
    
    // Transpose (swap dim 0 and 1)
    auto transposed = view.transpose(0, 1);
    assert(transposed.shape() == std::array<size_t, 3>{3, 2, 4});
    assert(transposed.strides() == std::array<size_t, 3>{4, 12, 1});
    assert(transposed(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);
    assert(transposed(1, 0, 0) == 4.0f);
    assert(transposed(0, 1, 0) == 12.0f);
    
    // Test strides_bytes for NumPy interop
    auto strides_bytes = view.strides_bytes();
    assert(strides_bytes[0] == 12 * sizeof(float));
    assert(strides_bytes[1] == 4 * sizeof(float));
    assert(strides_bytes[2] == 1 * sizeof(float));
}

void test_edge_cases() {
    // Empty range
```

```cpp
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <array>
#include <optional>
#include <limits>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>

// ============================================================================
// RATIONAL TIME ARITHMETIC (Frame-Accurate)
// ============================================================================

struct RationalTime {
    int64_t numerator = 0;
    int64_t denominator = 1;

    constexpr RationalTime() noexcept = default;
    constexpr RationalTime(int64_t num, int64_t den) noexcept : numerator(num), denominator(den) { normalize(); }

    void normalize() noexcept {
        if (denominator < 0) { numerator = -numerator; denominator = -denominator; }
        if (numerator == 0) { denominator = 1; return; }
        int64_t g = std::gcd(std::llabs(numerator), denominator);
        numerator /= g; denominator /= g;
    }

    constexpr double to_double() const noexcept { return static_cast<double>(numerator) / static_cast<double>(denominator); }

    friend constexpr bool operator==(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept {
        return a.numerator * b.denominator == b.numerator * a.denominator;
    }
    friend constexpr bool operator<(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept {
        return a.numerator * b.denominator < b.numerator * a.denominator;
    }
    friend constexpr bool operator<=(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept { return !(b < a); }
    friend constexpr bool operator>(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept { return b < a; }
    friend constexpr bool operator>=(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept { return !(a < b); }

    friend RationalTime operator+(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept {
        return RationalTime(a.numerator * b.denominator + b.numerator * a.denominator,
                            a.denominator * b.denominator);
    }
    friend RationalTime operator-(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept {
        return RationalTime(a.numerator * b.denominator - b.numerator * a.denominator,
                            a.denominator * b.denominator);
    }
    friend RationalTime operator*(const RationalTime& a, int64_t scalar) noexcept {
        return RationalTime(a.numerator * scalar, a.denominator);
    }
    friend RationalTime operator*(int64_t scalar, const RationalTime& a) noexcept { return a * scalar; }
};

// ============================================================================
// TIME RANGE & CLIP PRIMITIVES
// ============================================================================

struct TimeRange {
    RationalTime start_time;
    RationalTime duration;

    constexpr RationalTime end_time_exclusive() const noexcept { return start_time + duration; }
    constexpr bool contains(const RationalTime& t) const noexcept { return t >= start_time && t < end_time_exclusive(); }
    constexpr bool overlaps(const TimeRange& other) const noexcept {
        return start_time < other.end_time_exclusive() && other.start_time < end_time_exclusive();
    }
    std::optional<TimeRange> intersection(const TimeRange& other) const noexcept {
        RationalTime start = std::max(start_time, other.start_time);
        RationalTime end = std::min(end_time_exclusive(), other.end_time_exclusive());
        if (start < end) return TimeRange{start, end - start};
        return std::nullopt;
    }
};

struct Clip {
    TimeRange source_range;
    TimeRange target_range;
    int64_t media_id = -1;

    constexpr bool is_gap() const noexcept { return media_id == -1; }
};

// ============================================================================
// TRACK WITH ZERO-ALLOCATION GAP BUFFER
// ============================================================================

struct Track {
    std::vector<Clip> clips;
    RationalTime duration{0, 1};
    mutable std::vector<TimeRange> gap_buffer;

    void reserve_gaps(size_t capacity) { gap_buffer.reserve(capacity); }

    const std::vector<TimeRange>& find_gaps() const noexcept {
        gap_buffer.clear();
        if (clips.empty()) {
            if (duration.numerator > 0) gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{RationalTime{0,1}, duration});
            return gap_buffer;
        }
        RationalTime current{0, 1};
        for (const auto& clip : clips) {
            if (clip.target_range.start_time > current) {
                gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{current, clip.target_range.start_time - current});
            }
            current = clip.target_range.end_time_exclusive();
        }
        if (current < duration) gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{current, duration - current});
        return gap_buffer;
    }

    void resolve_gaps(bool extend_adjacent = true) {
        auto gaps = find_gaps();
        if (gaps.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Clip> new_clips;
        new_clips.reserve(clips.size() + gaps.size());
        size_t clip_idx = 0;
        RationalTime current{0, 1};
        for (const auto& gap : gaps) {
            while (clip_idx < clips.size() && clips[clip_idx].target_range.end_time_exclusive() <= gap.start_time) {
                new_clips.push_back(clips[clip_idx++]);
            }
            if (extend_adjacent && clip_idx > 0 && clip_idx < clips.size()) {
                Clip& prev = new_clips.back();
                prev.target_range.duration = prev.target_range.duration + gap.duration;
                prev.source_range.duration = prev.source_range.duration + gap.duration;
                current = gap.end_time_exclusive();
            } else {
                new_clips.push_back(Clip{TimeRange{gap.start_time, gap.duration}, TimeRange{gap.start_time, gap.duration}, -1});
                current = gap.end_time_exclusive();
            }
        }
        while (clip_idx < clips.size()) new_clips.push_back(clips[clip_idx++]);
        clips = std::move(new_clips);
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// RATIONAL TIME RESAMPLER (Frame-Rate Conversion)
// ============================================================================

class RationalTimeResampler {
    static RationalTime mul(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) noexcept {
        return RationalTime(a.numerator * b.numerator, a.denominator * b.denominator);
    }
public:
    static void resample_track(Track& track, const RationalTime& src_rate, const RationalTime& dst_rate) noexcept {
        if (src_rate == dst_rate) return;
        RationalTime factor{dst_rate.numerator * src_rate.denominator, dst_rate.denominator * src_rate.numerator};
        factor.normalize();
        for (auto& clip : track.clips) {
            clip.source_range.start_time = mul(clip.source_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.source_range.duration = mul(clip.source_range.duration, factor);
            clip.target_range.start_time = mul(clip.target_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.target_range.duration = mul(clip.target_range.duration, factor);
        }
        track.duration = mul(track.duration, factor);
    }
    static TimeRange resample_range(const TimeRange& r, const RationalTime& src, const RationalTime& dst) noexcept {
        RationalTime factor{dst.numerator * src.denominator, dst.denominator * src.numerator};
        factor.normalize();
        return TimeRange{mul(r.start_time, factor), mul(r.duration, factor)};
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// ZERO-COPY 3D TENSOR VIEW WITH STRIDE PERMUTATION
// ============================================================================

template<typename T>
class Tensor3DView {
public:
    using pointer = T*;
    using const_pointer = const T*;
    using size_type = size_t;

    Tensor3DView() noexcept = default;
    Tensor3DView(pointer data, size_type d0, size_type d1, size_type d2,
                 std::array<size_type,3> strides = {}) noexcept
        : data_(data), dims_{d0,d1,d2} {
        if (strides.empty()) { strides_[0]=d1*d2; strides_[1]=d2; strides_[2]=1; }
        else strides_ = strides;
    }

    Tensor3DView permute(std::array<int,3> order) const noexcept {
        std::array<size_type,3> nd, ns;
        for(int i=0;i<3;++i){ nd[i]=dims_[order[i]]; ns[i]=strides_[order[i]]; }
        return Tensor3DView(data_, nd[0],nd[1],nd[2], ns);
    }
    Tensor3DView transpose(int d0, int d1) const noexcept {
        std::array<int,3> o={0,1,2}; std::swap(o[d0],o[d1]); return permute(o);
    }

    T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) noexcept {
        assert(i<dims_[0] && j<dims_[1] && k<dims_[2]);
        return data_[i*strides_[0] + j*strides_[1] + k*strides_[2]];
    }
    const T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) const noexcept {
        assert(i<dims_[0] && j<dims_[1] && k<dims_[2]);
        return data_[i*strides_[0] + j*strides_[1] + k*strides_[2]];
    }

    pointer data() noexcept { return data_; }
    const_pointer data() const noexcept { return data_; }
    std::array<size_type,3> shape() const noexcept { return dims_; }
    std::array<size_type,3> strides() const noexcept { return strides_; }
    std::array<size_type,3> strides_bytes() const noexcept {
        return {strides_[0]*sizeof(T), strides_[1]*sizeof(T), strides_[2]*sizeof(T)};
    }
    size_type size() const noexcept { return dims_[0]*dims_[1]*dims_[2]; }
    bool is_contiguous() const noexcept {
        return strides_[0]==dims_[1]*dims_[2] && strides_[1]==dims_[2] && strides_[2]==1;
    }
private:
    pointer data_ = nullptr;
    std::array<size_type,3> dims_{0,0,0};
    std::array<size_type,3> strides_{0,0,0};
};

// TIMELINE COMPOSER (OPENTIMELINEIO STYLE)
// ============================================================================

class TimelineComposer {
public:
    struct CompositionResult {
        std::vector<Clip> composed_clips;
        std::vector<TimeRange> unresolved_gaps;
        bool success = true;
    };

    static CompositionResult compose_tracks(const std::vector<Track*>& tracks, const RationalTime& timeline_duration) {
        CompositionResult result;
        size_t total = 0; for (auto* t : tracks) total += t->clips.size();
        std::vector<Clip> all; all.reserve(total);
        for (auto* t : tracks) for (const auto& c : t->clips) all.push_back(c);
        std::sort(all.begin(), all.end(),
            [](const Clip& a, const Clip& b){ return a.target_range.start_time < b.target_range.start_time; });

        std::vector<Clip> merged; merged.reserve(all.size());
        for (const auto& clip : all) {
            if (merged.empty() || !merged.back().target_range.overlaps(clip.target_range)) {
                merged.push_back(clip);
            } else {
                auto& last = merged.back();
                auto inter = last.target_range.intersection(clip.target_range);
                if (inter) {
                    if (last.target_range.start_time < inter->start_time) {
                        Clip prefix = last;
                        prefix.target_range.duration = inter->start_time - last.target_range.start_time;
                        prefix.source_range.duration = inter->start_time - last.source_range.start_time;
                        merged.back() = prefix;
                        merged.push_back(clip);
                        if (last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() > inter->end_time_exclusive()) {
                            Clip suffix = last;
                            suffix.target_range.start_time = inter->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.target_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - inter->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.source_range.start_time = inter->end_time_exclusive() - last.target_range.start_time + last.source_range.start_time;
                            suffix.source_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - inter->end_time_exclusive();
                            merged.push_back(suffix);
                        }
                    } else {
                        merged.back() = clip;
                    }
                } else merged.push_back(clip);
            }
        }

        RationalTime cur{0,1};
        for (const auto& c : merged) {
            if (c.target_range.start_time > cur)
                result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(TimeRange{cur, c.target_range.start_time - cur});
            cur = c.target_range.end_time_exclusive();
        }
        if (cur < timeline_duration)
            result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(TimeRange{cur, timeline_duration - cur});

        result.composed_clips = std::move(merged);
        return result;
    }

void test_rational_time() {
    RationalTime a{1,24}, b{1,30};
    assert(a < RationalTime{1,12});
    assert(RationalTime{2,24} == RationalTime{1,12});
    auto sum = a + b; assert(sum.numerator==54 && sum.denominator==720);
    auto diff = a - RationalTime{1,48}; assert(diff.numerator==1 && diff.denominator==48);
    RationalTime neg{-1,24}; neg.normalize(); assert(neg.numerator==-1 && neg.denominator==24);
    RationalTime negd{1,-24}; negd.normalize(); assert(negd.numerator==-1 && negd.denominator==24);
}

void test_time_range() {
    TimeRange r1{{0,1},{10,1}}, r2{{5,1},{10,1}}, r3{{10,1},{5,1}}, r4{{15,1},{5,1}};
    assert(r1.overlaps(r2)); assert(!r1.overlaps(r3)); assert(!r1.overlaps(r4));
    auto i = r1.intersection(r2); assert(i && i->start_time==RationalTime{5,1} && i->duration==RationalTime{5,1});
    assert(!r1.intersection(r3).has_value());
    assert(r1.contains({0,1})); assert(r1.contains({9,1})); assert(!r1.contains({10,1})); assert(!r1.contains({-1,1}));
}

void test_track_gaps() {
    Track t; t.duration={100,1}; t.reserve_gaps(10);
    auto g = t.find_gaps(); assert(g.size()==1 && g[0].duration==RationalTime{100,1});
    t.clips = {
        {{0,1},{10,1}, {0,1},{10,1}, 1},
        {{10,1},{10,1}, {20,1},{10,1}, 2},
        {{20,1},{10,1}, {30,1},{10,1}, 3}
    };
    g = t.find_gaps(); assert(g.size()==2);
    assert(g[0].start_time==RationalTime{10,1} && g[0].duration==RationalTime{10,1});
    assert(g[1].start_time==RationalTime{40,1} && g[1].duration==RationalTime{60,1});
    t.resolve_gaps(true);
    assert(t.clips.size()==3 && t.clips[0].target_range.duration==RationalTime{20,1});
    assert(t.clips[1].target_range.start_time==RationalTime{20,1});

    Track t2; t2.duration={100,1}; t2.reserve_gaps(10);
    t2.clips = { {{0,1},{10,1}, {0,1},{10,1}, 1}, {{10,1},{10,1}, {30,1},{10,1}, 2} };
    t2.resolve_gaps(false);
    assert(t2.clips.size()==3 && t2.clips[1].is_gap());
    assert(t2.clips[1].target_range.start_time==RationalTime{10,1} && t2.clips[1].target_range.duration==RationalTime{20,1});
}

void test_resampler() {
    Track t; t.duration={100,1};
    t.clips = { {{0,1},{24,1}, {0,1},{24,1}, 1}, {{24,1},{24,1}, {24,1},{24,1}, 2} };
    RationalTimeResampler::resample_track(t, {1,24}, {1,30});
    assert(t.clips[0].target_range.duration==RationalTime{30,30});
    assert(t.clips[1].target_range.duration==RationalTime{30,30});
    assert(t.duration==RationalTime{60,30});
}

void test_tensor3d_permute() {
    std::vector<float> data(24); std::iota(data.begin(), data.end(), 0.0f);
    Tensor3DView<float> v(data.data(), 2,3,4);
    assert(v.is_contiguous());
    assert(v(0,0,0)==0 && v(0,0,3)==3 && v(0,1,0)==4 && v(1,0,0)==12 && v(1,2,3)==23);
    auto p = v.permute({2,0,1});
    assert(p.shape()==std::array<size_t,3>{4,2,3});
    assert(p.strides()==std::array<size_t,3>{1,12,4});
    assert(p(0,0,0)==0 && p(3,0,0)==3 && p(0,0,1)==4 && p(0,1,0)==12 && p(3,1,2)==23);
    auto tr = v.transpose(0,1);
    assert(tr.shape()==std::array<size_t,3>{3,2,4});
    assert(tr.strides()==std::array<size_t,3>{4,12,1});
    assert(tr(0,0,0)==0 && tr(1,0,0)==4 && tr(0,1,0)==12);
    auto sb = v.strides_bytes();
    assert(sb[0]==12*sizeof(float) && sb[1]==4*sizeof(float) && sb[2]==1*sizeof(float));
}

void test_timeline_composer() {
    Track t1,t2; t1.duration={100,1}; t2.duration={100,1}; t1.reserve_gaps(10); t2.reserve_gaps(10);
    t1.clips = { {{0,1},{30,1}, {0,1},{30,1}, 1}, {{0,1},{30,1}, {50,1},{30,1}, 2} };
    t2.clips = { {{0,1},{40,1}, {20,1},{40,1}, 3} };
    auto r = TimelineComposer::compose_tracks({&t1,&t2}, {100,1});
    assert(r.composed_clips.size()==3);
    assert(r.composed_clips[0].target_range.start_time==RationalTime{0,1} && r.composed_clips[0].target_range.duration==RationalTime{20,1} && r.composed_clips[0].media_id==1);
    assert(r.composed_clips[1].target_range.start_time==RationalTime{20,1} && r.composed_clips[1].target_range.duration==RationalTime{40,1} && r.composed_clips[1].media_id==3);
    assert(r.composed_clips[2].target_range.start_time==RationalTime{60,1} && r.composed_clips[2].target_range.duration==RationalTime{20,1} && r.composed_clips[2].media_id==2);
    assert(r.unresolved_gaps.size()==1 && r.unresolved_gaps[0].start_time==RationalTime{80,1} && r.unresolved_gaps[0].duration==RationalTime{20,1});

    Track t3,t4; t3.duration={100,1}; t4.duration={100,1};
    t3.clips = { {{0,1},{50,1}, {0,1},{50,1}, 1} };
    t4.clips = { {{0,1},{50,1}, {50,1},{50,1}, 2} };
    auto r2 = TimelineComposer::compose_tracks({&t3,&t4}, {100,1});
    assert(r2.composed_clips.size()==2 && r2.unresolved_gaps.empty());
}

void test_edge_cases() {
    TimeRange empty{{0,1},{0,1}}; assert(empty.duration.numerator==0 && !empty.contains({0,1}));
    TimeRange neg{{-10,1},{20,1}}; assert(neg.start_time.numerator==-10 && neg.end_time_exclusive()==RationalTime{10,1});
    assert(neg.contains({0,1}) && !neg.contains({-10,1}) && neg.contains({-9,1}));
    TimeRange a{{0,1},{10,1}}, b{{10,1},{10,1}}; assert(!a.overlaps(b) && !a.intersection(b).has_value());
    Track t; t.duration={10,1}; t.clips = { {{5,1},{0,1}, {5,1},{0,1}, 1} };
    auto g = t.find_gaps(); assert(g.size()==2 && g[0].duration==RationalTime{5,1} && g[1].duration==RationalTime{5,1});
    RationalTime large{INT64_MAX/1000,1}, small{1,1000};
    auto sum = large + small; assert(sum.numerator > large.numerator);
}

int main() {
    std::cout << "Running verification harness...\n";
    test_rational_time(); std::cout << "  RationalTime tests passed\n";
    test_time_range(); std::cout << "  TimeRange tests passed\n";
    test_track_gaps(); std::cout << "  Track gap detection/resolution tests passed\n";
    test_resampler(); std::cout << "  RationalTimeResampler tests passed\n";
    test_tensor3d_permute(); std::cout << "  Tensor3DView permutation tests passed\n";
    test_timeline_composer(); std::cout << "  TimelineComposer tests passed\n";
    test_edge_cases(); std::cout << "  Edge case tests passed\n";
    std::cout << "\nAll tests passed successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}
```

- Rational arithmetic: O(log min(num,den)) per operation (GCD normalization)
- Gap detection: O(N) for N clips, zero allocations after `reserve_gaps()`
- Track composition: O(M log M) for M total clips across tracks (sort-dominated)
- Tensor permutation: O(1) zero-copy view transformation

```cpp
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ============================================================================
 * Register Map & Bit Definitions (Peripheral Specification)
 * ============================================================================ */
#define PERIPH_BASE_ADDR        0x40001000UL
#define PERIPH_SIZE             0x1000UL  /* 4KB Page */

#define REG_CTRL_OFFSET         0x00
#define REG_STATUS_OFFSET       0x04
#define REG_DATA_OFFSET         0x08
#define REG_IRQ_MASK_OFFSET     0x0C

/* CTRL Register Bits */
#define CTRL_EN_BIT             (1U << 0)
#define CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT         (1U << 1)
#define CTRL_DMA_EN_BIT         (1U << 2)
#define CTRL_RST_BIT            (1U << 31)

/* STATUS Register Bits (W1C - Write 1 to Clear) */
#define STAT_TX_DONE_BIT        (1U << 0)
#define STAT_RX_DONE_BIT        (1U << 1)
#define STAT_ERR_OVF_BIT        (1U << 2)
#define STAT_ERR_PARITY_BIT     (1U << 3)
#define STAT_BUSY_BIT           (1U << 31) /* Read-only status */

/* IRQ_MASK Register Bits */
#define IRQ_MASK_TX_DONE_BIT    (1U << 0)
#define IRQ_MASK_RX_DONE_BIT    (1U << 1)
#define IRQ_MASK_ERR_BIT        (1U << 2)

/* ============================================================================
 * Hardware Abstraction: Atomic MMIO Access (ARMv8-A SMP Safe)
 * ============================================================================ */
/*
 * On ARMv8-A (Cortex-A78), Device-nGnRnE memory type requires:
 * - Acquire semantics on Load (LDAR) to ensure subsequent loads/stores observe
 *   the peripheral state after the read.
 * - Release semantics on Store (STLR) to ensure prior loads/stores are visible
 *   to the peripheral before the register write.
 * C11 atomic_load_explicit/store_explicit with memory_order_acquire/release
 * maps directly to LDAR/STLR.
 */
typedef struct {
    _Atomic(uint32_t) ctrl;       /* 0x00: RW */
    _Atomic(uint32_t) status;     /* 0x04: R / W1C */
    _Atomic(uint32_t) data;       /* 0x08: RW */
    _Atomic(uint32_t) irq_mask;   /* 0x0C: RW */
} periph_regs_t;

/* Simulated Physical Memory (4KB Page Aligned) */
static uint8_t g_mmio_backing[PERIPH_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static periph_regs_t * const g_periph = (periph_regs_t *)g_mmio_backing;

/* ============================================================================
 * Driver API
 * ============================================================================ */

static inline void periph_ctrl_write(uint32_t val) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->ctrl, val, memory_order_release);
}

static inline uint32_t periph_ctrl_read(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->ctrl, memory_order_acquire);
}

static inline uint32_t periph_status_read(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->status, memory_order_acquire);
}

/*
 * W1C (Write-1-to-Clear) Operation:
 * Hardware clears bits where '1' is written. Bits written '0' are unaffected.
 * This is a simple store-release. No RMW loop needed in SW because HW handles
 * the masking atomically per-bit.
 */
static inline void periph_status_clear(uint32_t clear_mask) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->status, clear_mask, memory_order_release);
}

static inline uint32_t periph_data_read(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->data, memory_order_acquire);
}

static inline void periph_data_write(uint32_t val) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->data, val, memory_order_release);
}

static inline uint32_t periph_irq_mask_read(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->irq_mask, memory_order_acquire);
}

static inline void periph_irq_mask_write(uint32_t mask) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->irq_mask, mask, memory_order_release);
}

/* Higher Level Helpers */
static inline void periph_enable(bool en) {
    uint32_t ctrl = periph_ctrl_read();
    if (en) ctrl |= CTRL_EN_BIT; else ctrl &= ~CTRL_EN_BIT;
    periph_ctrl_write(ctrl);
}

static inline bool periph_is_busy(void) {
    return (periph_status_read() & STAT_BUSY_BIT) != 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Test Harness: Simulated Hardware Side-Effects
 * ============================================================================ */
/*
 * In a real system, the peripheral hardware updates STATUS/DATA asynchronously.
 * Here we simulate that by directly manipulating the backing store to verify
 * driver W1C logic and register mapping.
 */
static void sim_hw_set_status(uint32_t bits) {
    /* Simulate HW setting status bits (Atomic RMW on backing store) */
    uint32_t old = atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->status, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->status, old | bits, memory_order_relaxed);
}

static void sim_hw_clear_busy(void) {
    uint32_t old = atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->status, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->status, old & ~STAT_BUSY_BIT, memory_order_relaxed);
}

static void sim_hw_set_busy(void) {
    uint32_t old = atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->status, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_periph->status, old | STAT_BUSY_BIT, memory_order_relaxed);
}

static uint32_t sim_hw_get_ctrl(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->ctrl, memory_order_relaxed);
}

static uint32_t sim_hw_get_irq_mask(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_periph->irq_mask, memory_order_relaxed);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Main: Deterministic Verification
 * ============================================================================ */
int main(void) {
    /* 1. Zero Initialize Simulated MMIO Page */
    memset(g_mmio_backing, 0, PERIPH_SIZE);
    assert(g_periph == (periph_regs_t *)PERIPH_BASE_ADDR || "Test assumes identity mapping for sim");

    /* 2. Verify Reset State */
    assert(periph_ctrl_read() == 0);
    assert(periph_status_read() == 0);
    assert(periph_data_read() == 0);
    assert(periph_irq_mask_read() == 0);

    /* 3. Test CTRL RW & Bit Ops */
    periph_ctrl_write(CTRL_EN_BIT | CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT);
    assert(periph_ctrl_read() == (CTRL_EN_BIT | CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT));
    assert(sim_hw_get_ctrl() == (CTRL_EN_BIT | CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT)); /* Verify HW view */

    periph_ctrl_write(CTRL_DMA_EN_BIT); /* Overwrite */
    assert(periph_ctrl_read() == CTRL_DMA_EN_BIT);

    /* 4. Test DATA RW */
    periph_data_write(0xDEADBEEF);
    assert(periph_data_read() == 0xDEADBEEF);

    /* 5. Test IRQ_MASK RW */
    periph_irq_mask_write(IRQ_MASK_TX_DONE_BIT | IRQ_MASK_ERR_BIT);
    assert(periph_irq_mask_read() == (IRQ_MASK_TX_DONE_BIT | IRQ_MASK_ERR_BIT));
    assert(sim_hw_get_irq_mask() == (IRQ_MASK_TX_DONE_BIT | IRQ_MASK_ERR_BIT));

    /* 6. Test STATUS W1C Semantics (Core Requirement) */
    /* Simulate Hardware asserting TX_DONE, RX_DONE, and ERROR simultaneously */
    sim_hw_set_status(STAT_TX_DONE_BIT | STAT_RX_DONE_BIT | STAT_ERR_OVF_BIT);
    uint32_t status = periph_status_read();
    assert(status == (STAT_TX_DONE_BIT | STAT_RX_DONE_BIT | STAT_ERR_OVF_BIT));

    /* Clear ONLY TX_DONE (Write 1 to bit 0) */
    periph_status_clear(STAT_TX_DONE_BIT);
    status = periph_status_read();
    assert((status & STAT_TX_DONE_BIT) == 0);           /* Cleared */
    assert((status & STAT_RX_DONE_BIT) != 0);           /* Preserved */
    assert((status & STAT_ERR_OVF_BIT) != 0);           /* Preserved */

    /* Clear RX_DONE and ERR_OVF together */
    periph_status_clear(STAT_RX_DONE_BIT | STAT_ERR_OVF_BIT);
    status = periph_status_read();
    assert(status == 0); /* All cleared */

    /* 7. Test W1C Idempotency / Writing Zeros */
    sim_hw_set_status(STAT_TX_DONE_BIT);
```

```cpp
    // Test Polygon: Svalbard Arctic Satellite Pass (High Latitude)
    // Approx 78.22 N, 15.0 E to 78.5 N, 16.0 E region.
    // Vertices ordered CCW (Positive Area).
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    std::vector<LLH> poly = {
        {78.2200, 15.0000, 0},
        {78.2200, 16.0000, 0},
        {78.5000, 16.0000, 0},
        {78.5000, 15.0000, 0}
    };
    // Close polygon implicitly in algorithms
    
    try {
        validate_polygon(poly);
        std::cout << "[OK] Polygon Validation Passed (Non-degenerate, Simple).\n";
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[FAIL] Validation Error: " << e.what() << "\n";
        return 1;
    }

    // 1. Planar Shoelace (ENU Projection)
    double A_planar = area_planar_shoelace(poly);
    
    // 2. Spherical (Authalic Sphere) - Girard / L'Huilier
    double A_spherical = area_spherical_lhuilier(poly);
    
    // 3. Ellipsoidal Geodesic (WGS84) - "Ground Truth"
    GeodesicAreaAccumulator acc;
    size_t n = poly.size();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        size_t j = (i + 1) % n;
        double lat1 = poly[i].lat * DEG2RAD;
        double lon1 = poly[i].lon * DEG2RAD;
        double lat2 = poly[j].lat * DEG2RAD;
        double lon2 = poly[j].lon * DEG2RAD;
        acc.add_edge(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2);
    }
    double A_ellipsoidal = acc.get_area();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Reporting & Invariant Checks
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    std::cout << "\n--- Area Computation Results (m^2) ---\n";
    std::cout << "Planar (ENU Shoelace)     : " << A_planar << "\n";
    std::cout << "Spherical (Authalic/L'Huil): " << A_spherical << "\n";
    std::cout << "Ellipsoidal (WGS84 Geod)  : " << A_ellipsoidal << "\n";
    
    double rel_err_planar = std::abs(A_planar - A_ellipsoidal) / A_ellipsoidal;
    double rel_err_spherical = std::abs(A_spherical - A_ellipsoidal) / A_ellipsoidal;
    
    std::cout << "\n--- Relative Error vs WGS84 Geodesic ---\n";
    std::cout << "Planar Error    : " << (rel_err_planar * 100.0) << " %\n";
    std::cout << "Spherical Error : " << (rel_err_spherical * 100.0) << " %\n";

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Assertions (Geodetic Invariants)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // At 78 deg N, 1 deg Lon ~ 21 km. Polygon ~ 30km x 110km ~ 3.3e9 m^2.
    // Planar (ENU) distortion at high lat: Meridians converge. 
    // ENU projection is tangent at center. Error scales with (Extent / Radius)^2.
    // Expected Planar Error ~ 0.1% - 0.5% for this size at 78N.
    // Spherical (Authalic) Error vs Ellipsoidal: ~ 0.01% (flattening effect).
    
    const double TOL_PLANAR = 1e-2;     // 1% tolerance for planar approx at high lat
    const double TOL_SPHERICAL = 5e-4;  // 0.05% tolerance for spherical vs ellipsoidal
    
    bool ok = true;
    if (rel_err_planar > TOL_PLANAR) {
        std::cerr << "[ASSERT FAIL] Planar error exceeds tolerance (" << TOL_PLANAR*100 << "%).\n";
        ok = false;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[ASSERT OK] Planar error within tolerance.\n";
    }
    
    if (rel_err_spherical > TOL_SPHERICAL) {
        std::cerr << "[ASSERT FAIL] Spherical (Authalic) error exceeds tolerance (" << TOL_SPHERICAL*100 << "%).\n";
        ok = false;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[ASSERT OK] Spherical error within tolerance.\n";
    }

    // Degeneracy Test
    std::cout << "\n--- Degeneracy Rejection Test ---\n";
    std::vector<LLH> bad_poly = {{78.0, 15.0, 0}, {78.1, 15.0, 0}, {78.2, 15.0, 0}}; // Collinear
    try {
        validate_polygon(bad_poly);
        std::cerr << "[ASSERT FAIL] Collinear polygon accepted.\n";
        ok = false;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cout << "[ASSERT OK] Collinear rejected: " << e.what() << "\n";
    }

    std::vector<LLH> bowtie = {{78.0, 15.0, 0}, {78.1, 16.0, 0}, {78.0, 16.0, 0}, {78.1, 15.0, 0}};
    try {
        validate_polygon(bowtie);
        std::cerr << "[ASSERT FAIL] Self-intersecting polygon accepted.\n";
        ok = false;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cout << "[ASSERT OK] Self-intersecting rejected: " << e.what() << "\n";
    }

    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}
```

**Complexity Note:**
*   **Validation:** $O(N^2)$ for planar self-intersection check (edge pairs), $O(N)$ for spherical collinearity. $N$ = vertex count.
*   **Planar Area:** $O(N)$ (Shoelace on projected ENU coordinates).
*   **Spherical Area (L'Huilier):** $O(N)$ (Fan triangulation with stable $\tan(E/4)$ formula).
*   **Ellipsoidal Area (Geodesic):** $O(N)$ (Auxiliary sphere mapping with 5th-order flattening series $C_4$).
*   **Memory:** $O(N)$ for vertex storage. No dynamic allocation in hot paths (reserved vectors).
*   **Numerical Stability:** L'Huilier's formula avoids $\arccos$ cancellation for small excesses. Authalic latitude series converges rapidly for WGS84 ($n \approx 1/600$).
